title: Chapter 108 Change
content:
Chapter 108 Change

When all the troops are assembled, they form a formation one by one, come to the enemy's wall, and prepare to attack the city. The two of you are also pushed over with the same siege weapon, and the atmosphere of the battle is once again. diffuse over the entire battlefield.

The first siege must be the biggest loss. Sun Jian, who has already turned against him, must be reluctant to let those trustworthy and loyal imperial troops under his command who have been trained for a long time and are extremely elite.

But those losses in the siege must be borne by someone, which made Sun Jian turn his head and look at the leaders of the barbarian tribes around him who had taken refuge in him.

Would they think he still has three thousand cannon fodder? It's not just right to take it out to fill these cities. Seeing Sun Jian's gaze, many barbarian leaders around couldn't help crying secretly. The reason why they took refuge in Sun Jian was to reduce the loss of their own tribe and even gain some benefits.

But now, the advantage is that I haven't seen any of them, but batch after batch of young and strong men of the tribe have been sent to the battlefield. There were only 3,000 soldiers left in the original 8,000. I don't know how many women are old and weak, and will lose their husbands, fathers and sons.

This is another difficult task, and I am still thinking about how to go back and explain to those people? Now that they want to send people like themselves to the battlefield, how can they be willing? The resentment in my heart can't help bursting out!

But looking at the back of the middle, the generals who put their hands on the hilts one by one? As well as the soldiers around him who had already clenched their sharp blades, all of them looked at him with malicious intentions, and they couldn't help feeling pale and sweating.

"Patriarchs, leaders, now is the time when my royal kingdom employs people. Since you chiefs have taken refuge in my royal family, you always want to do meritorious service for my great man and win a chance to be promoted. Now the opportunity has come. The city in front of you is at this moment. I need all of you warriors to step down, and when you are successful, you will be granted titles and bestowed upon your wives and sons, no problem!" Sun Jian said sadly.

"My lord general, I and other tribal warriors have been on the battlefield before, and most of them were lost. Now there are only 3,000 men left in this area. This is to keep them for hunting and feeding for the tribe, defending against enemies, and it is the seed of the continuation of the tribe! Today The fight will continue, and the last 3,000 male soldiers will be wiped out. Our tribe will really die, and I hope that the general will be kind and understand the difficulties of our small tribe!" After finishing speaking, the leaders of these tribes knelt down in unison. Going down, his forehead kept knocking on the uneven ground, and blood flowed all over the floor.

"Hmph! I don't care about these things. I just want to know that your performance is a chance to refuse to serve the Royal Kingdom. You dare to shirk this kind of supreme glory. Could it be that you have two hearts in your heart? You want to betray my big brother?" Yuguo?" As he spoke, there was a hint of murderous intent in his soft words, and the generals and soldiers behind Sun Jian also pulled out their weapons in unison, pointed at them all, and looked at those soldiers with unkind eyes. tribal leader.

"No...don't dare, the villain is going to summon the warriors of the tribe to break through the city in front of me for the Great Yu Kingdom. The villain has no second intentions. Please forgive me, General!"

Several barbarian leaders were sweating coldly on their foreheads. Seeing the scene where they were about to draw their swords when they saw this disagreement, they thought that there were only 3,000 people on their side, and there were 30,000 people in front of them. They were not opponents at all, so they could only speak out He answered, bit the bullet and prepared to go.

"Since this is the case, this general is not unreasonable. Before this general, I still had some armor and armor in my army. Several leaders went with the quartermaster to get enough equipment for the soldiers. It would be better to have more means of life-saving on the battlefield. !"

Seeing that the barbarian leaders surrendered, Sun Jian's originally stiff face eased, he spoke a word of comfort, and gave them some armor, so that they could live longer and kill more enemy soldiers for themselves.

A few barbarians thanked them, followed the quartermaster to the arsenal with mournful faces, and received weapons and armor, so that they could be distributed to the warriors under their own tribe, so that they could live a few more people on the battlefield and save some for their tribe. Live it up!

It took a long time to collect weapons and distribute soldiers, but in fact it only took half an hour!

With the help of the imperial soldiers who had been prepared for a long time, three thousand sets of armor and weapons were sent to the barbarian camp in a short while, and they were monitored to put them on, and then went to the battlefield together!

Just like that, a group of angry and dejected barbarian soldiers were behind them, and the 5,000 imperial soldiers rushed to the battlefield under pressure and surveillance.

The Wogo tribe warriors in the city of Wogo, at this moment, their patriarch did not inform their gods that they were going to attack, so they were still confused.

Seeing the enemies outside his city dispatching troops again, all the defenders couldn't help but change their expressions.

The war in the past few days was far more tragic than they imagined. In just a few days, the original 8,000 warriors lost 5,000, leaving only 3,000.

This period was originally just an experience, and some small tribes under the Kuller Tribal Alliance fought a small war with hundreds of people and a maximum of 3,000 people.

I have never fought such a strategic war with tens of thousands of people, which can be called a small battle, so how can I not be frightened by the cruelty of this war.

Many people's former partners used to hunt and drink together, but their good lives disappeared in a few days here.

How can they not let them fear that they will do the same, and lose their lives at some point, just look at those warriors, and the many pale-faced and trembling companions around them can see the panic in their hearts!

However, before they could wait for the enemy's attack, they found that their patriarch and a group of elders were standing on the top of the city with a smile on his face, looking contemptuously at the enemy troops in front of him who were slowly approaching their city wall.

Patriarch, is this crazy? That's an army of tens of thousands!

Even if the patriarch's strength is as high as Tier 4, it can't hide the fact that there are only 3,000 defenders in the city. With our strength, we will definitely not be able to resist another attack from the enemy.

As long as the enemy's commander-in-chief can be ruthless and pay tens of thousands of casualties, it will be absolutely no problem to take down this broken city that is already dilapidated, lacks supplies, and suffers heavy losses of personnel in the city.

While all the barbarian soldiers were thinking wildly, some soldiers were shocked to find that their city walls were high above the sky.

A mass of extremely rich golden light appeared, dazzling and dazzling, and it was impossible to look directly at it.

At the same time, it also has a great sense of majesty and holiness, which makes people want to bow down and bow down, expressing their humility and respect to the sacred thing.

The imperial army outside the city also saw this golden light, and those inside the imperial army naturally didn't know what it was.

But those barbarian cannon fodder, and the leaders and patriarchs of those barbarians, as local aborigines, it is impossible for them not to know!

That is the clan god worshiped by the tribe in this city before their eyes! Legend has it that the divine fire has been ignited, and it is only the last step to condense the godhead, the god of the Vogo tribe.

Thinking of the previous wars and the power beyond the imagination of ordinary people after the attack of various legendary gods, Qiqi couldn't help but stop for a step, and dare not move forward again.
